procedure: Small number of direct public HTTPS GET requests, verified TLS, no authentication, no implicit redirects or user-agent impersonation. No CAPTCHA, paywall or access-control bypass. Article bodies were not persisted.

observations.finding: General web paths are not categorically disallowed; robots excludes /api*/ and administrative paths. No sitemap was declared.
Small landing page with links naming the beta/current site; no historical article listing.
Public editorial selection for 2010 with article links. Not an exhaustive archive; year/month in target URLs do not establish a complete publication date.
Cloudflare challenge page. No usable monthly listing. Access was not circumvented.
One article followed from the public 2010 index returned a Cloudflare challenge, without usable publication date or article metadata. No alternate route was attempted.
Robots allows named crawlers but sets User-agent: * / Disallow: /. The MDH-SV user agent is not among the named agents. No identity impersonation was attempted.
Publisher security page explicitly says the request was blocked. No further automated article/archive requests were attempted.

operational_conclusion.El Faro: A limited public historical index was found, but automated article/monthly access tested was restricted. Do not invent exact dates from monthly URLs or represent the source as a working exhaustive archive collector.
operational_conclusion.La Prensa Gráfica: Mark automated collection as restricted pending a permitted integration or publisher arrangement. Prior search-engine access to individual articles is not evidence that this collector is authorized or operational.
